description: Turns the credits of one period's latest finished credit run into Earning rows: each credit's plan is resolved as of its date, and every payout rule on that plan pays either a flat rate on the credit or a tiered rate chosen by the payee's attainment against a quota. Dry run by default.
name: ICM | Calculate Payouts
